## Checklist

- [ ] Branched from `upstream/main`, not from my fork's `main`
- [ ] No personal files: nothing named `local-*`, no `system-info.md`, no `.project`
- [ ] No personal data: no ADT connection names, user names, passwords or system URLs
- [ ] Object names follow the `ZRK_` convention in `.github/copilot-instructions.md`
- [ ] Links and paths to other files (`.github/reference/…`, `.github/templates/…`, other prompts) still resolve
- [ ] New prompt / skill / agent: `description` says when to use it; skill `name` matches its folder name
- [ ] Tried it in Copilot Chat at least once against a real object or requirement
